metadata.description: REAPER Notator 3.0 (Exclusive Edition) — Proprietary native musical notation, score editing, and engraving environment for Cockos REAPER. Requires ReaImGui v0.10+ and Reaticulate. Copyright (C) 2026 A-intheCode. All Rights Reserved.

version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v3.1: Major Feature & Engine Update: Massive upgrade of Melodic Pathfinder (Orchestra, Guitar & Bass, and Percussions / Drums modes, Reference Profile blending, dedicated Select Notes marquee mode, Merge Selected Notes / Overridden Note locks, and Note Length Multiplier — see Manual for details), plus improvements for Hairpins & Crescendos and Articulation Switching + v3.01: Update & Hotfix: Add multilingual '• Dot (×1.5) [.]' toggle button in the Left Sidebar under Note Values (toggles augmentation dot on selected notes or for new note input), exact grid-aligned MIDI note durations (0-tick gap on repeated same-pitch notes in Write Notes [D] & Step Input, 0-tick overlap on Slurs), chord slur target pitch resolution, and independent chord note & slur deletion + v3.0: Major Exclusive Release: REAPER Notator 3.0 — Protected Closed-Source Binary Core Architecture, Multi-Staff Engraving, Synthesizer V Studio Pro 2 Live Bridge, Automatic Articulation Negative Delay Scanner, Guitar/Bass Tablature, Melodic Pathfinder 2.0, Circle of Fifths & 1,500 Orchestral Patterns
